# routeros_ip_smb_users (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ip_smb_users" "guest" {
  name     = "guest"
  disabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item.

### Optional

- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the SMB user.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the user may only read shares.

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) It's the default item.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/ip/smb/users get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_ip_smb_users.guest *1
```
